memory_candidates.content: This harness's (Claude Code 2.1.322) foreground Bash call backgrounding ceiling measures at exactly 600s when the tool's own timeout parameter is raised to 600000, not ~180s as one self-reported incident in a different repository/session claimed. Calls at 170s/190s/350s/590s with timeout=600000 all completed synchronously with exact elapsed-time match; a 620s call was backgrounded with the harness message explicitly naming '600s timeout'. Before trusting a carried ceiling figure from an incident report, re-measure directly with bracketed sleep calls at several durations rather than assuming the self-report's number is a calibrated measurement.
